title: Cutting theft without chasing people
target: How to use the security equipment in Supermarket Simulator to cut theft, instead of spending the day running after customers.
version: 1.6.0 (223), read from the copy of the game this site was built from (see the sources page)
prerequisites: A shop with customers coming through the door
Money for a camera or a guard
Somebody watching the shop rather than only the till

steps.do: Fit a camera before buying anything else, because it works while you are at the counter.
steps.because: the game ships cameras as placed objects with their own interaction (SecurityCamera)

steps.do: Put the camera where goods leave rather than where they are shelved.
steps.because: a camera keeps a saved record of where you placed it (SecurityCameraSaveData)

steps.do: Hire a guard when you cannot watch the floor yourself.
steps.because: the guard has behaviour of his own and patrols rather than standing still (SecurityGuardStateController)

steps.do: Expect a guard to notice things you are not looking at.
steps.because: the guard has an antenna with a detection area of its own (SecurityAntennaDetechArea)

steps.do: Do not treat security as a replacement for watching the warning indicator.
steps.because: the shoplifter warning is a separate system from the cameras (SecurityCameraInteraction)

commonMistakes: Buying a guard while the goods walk out of an unwatched door.
Assuming a camera removes the need to watch the warning.
Fitting a camera and never checking what it actually covers.
sources: A local copy of the game, read only. Grounding for each step is on the technical reference pages; no number is estimated.
